messages:
alex: FYI saw a regression on sm86 after yesterday's kernel-autotune bump. p95 latency up ~18% for microbatch=2 workloads. suspect the prefetch change is evicting KV cache and forcing slow matmul kernel path. attaching quick profiler dump.

maria: Can you paste the profiler snippet + the kernel route decision log? Also which driver (537?) and cu libs?

alex: driver 537.21, cuBLAS 12.3. Profiler: 
```
workload: chat-infer microbatch=2 seq=128
p50: 42ms p95: 120ms
kvcache hits: 72% -> 38% after change
kernel_route: fast_sm86_fp16_tc -> fallback_block_mm (higher regs)
reason: kv_eviction(prefetch) + seqlen_gateway (seq128)
profiling_id: dump-5611112222
```

jonathan: hm looks like prefetch now pulls next-token kv pages earlier which is great for seq32/64, but for microbatch=2 and seq128 it increases working set and thrashes L2/KV region. :thinking_face:

maria: Could be eviction + heuristic that switches to fallback kernel when kvcache miss ratio crosses 50%. Do we still have hysteresis?

alex: Old autotune had 10% hysteresis, new change reduced to 2% to be more responsive. That probably explains the flip.

jonathan: If route flips it picks a kernel with larger register pressure and no tensor-core path for our layout, so per-token compute increases. We should reintroduce longer hysteresis for seqlen>64 microbatch<=4.

maria: Agree. Also want to check if SM feature detect (sm version -> tensor core bf16/fp8 gating) misreported on some nodes causing kernel pick to be conservative. Any mismatches in sm signature logs?

alex: Found a few nodes with sm86 reported correctly but the capflag for bf16_tensorcore was false due to a PCI enumeration race on warmboot. Log snippet: 
```
[probe] sm_major=8 sm_minor=6 caps: tensorcore=true bf16=true fp8=false
[post-init] capflag_bf16=false (overwritten by pci-probe timeout)
```

jonathan: That would force fallback kernels too. Two things: (1) fix pci probe ordering so capability flags win against late timeouts, (2) revert hysteresis change for the affected seqlen/microbatch bucket.

alex: I ran a quick ablation: revert hysteresis -> p95 back to 102ms. Re-enable bf16 flag override -> p95 98ms. Combined -> baseline 95ms.

maria: Nice. Can you create a short PR: revert hysteresis threshold change + add small guard for pci-probe race (retry once with 200ms backoff). Include a perf test in the autotune e2e harness that runs microbatch=2 seq=128.

alex: Will do. Opening PR now. Also adding a telemetry tag so we can see how often route flips per-tenant in the next 24h.

sre-bot: Incident created #INC-2026: "sm86 microbatch prefetch-induced route flip causing p95 regressions" (severity: low -> monitoring)

tara: Thanks team. Action items: alex PR for hysteresis & pci probe guard; maria add e2e perf case + dashboard; jonathan follow up on kernel path selection docs (seqlen gating). Check back in 24h. :thumbsup:

alex: PR 8159 opened: revert hysteresis + pci-probe retry. link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/8159 :eyes:

maria: I'll add the perf case and a dashboard tile. throwing a canary to the small fleet now.

jonathan: I'll update kernel-selection.md with the seqlen & microbatch heuristics we discussed.

alex: Thanks. I'll watch telemetry and post results here.
